implementation_notes: C has no shared constant facility, so the authoritative home is a header with `static inline` functions or `enum` constants, included everywhere it is needed. Header-only reuse without `static`/`inline` produces duplicate symbols at link time — a literal C-level DRY failure.
idiom_name: header with static inline functions / enum constants
pitfalls: Non-static functions in headers cause multiple-definition link errors
Macro constants leak into the global preprocessor namespace
